Before this day

Before forever, there were little moments.

Our best memories are rarely about where we went. They live in the photographs we took, the conversations that ran longer than planned, the evenings neither of us wanted to end and the cups of chai that became part of every plan. Little things, perhaps. But they are the things we will carry with us all our lives.

01 · THE CAFE DAYS

Her favourite cafés.
His favourite chai.

She taught him that a café can feel like an occasion. He taught her that chai tastes better when nobody is checking the time. Somewhere in between, one hour became three, and neither of us noticed. We were too busy laughing.

He laughed first. She held out for exactly three seconds.
02 · THE EVENINGS WE KEPT

A little distance.
A lot to look forward to.

Our time together had to be planned around work and distance, so none of it was ever taken for granted. A beach at sunset, wind in our hair, the sky turning blue above us and both of us grinning like fools. Each of us walked away wishing for just ten more minutes.

Sea, sunset, and ten more minutes.
03 · OUR USUAL TWO

Two chais.
And no hurry.

Tea in small glass tumblers with palm trees swaying outside. His ghazals, her cafés, his books, her best outfit, and a shared habit of never rushing. Somewhere in between, we built our own quiet rituals. They were never grand, only ours, and they turned out to be the best part of every day.

One for you. One for me. Always.
